fusions.name: Leaden Stoop
fusions.desc: Drops all your weight on the target for 14 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds, and drives it back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Plumb Line
fusions.desc: Drops from a height for 28 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the full 8 tiles. The blow ignores the target's armour.

fusions.name: Turned Back
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each affliction laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Cold Resolve
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
